text: Spirit Wisps are small drifting spirits of the March, trailing little motes of light. They float rather than walk and never take fall damage.
You find them in all six biomes, in loose groups over grass, stone and crystal. They gather most around March Crystal.
A wisp watches you from a distance but keeps about four blocks away, and it flees if something startles it.
It has only **6 health**, never attacks and drops nothing. Think of it as the March's fireflies: a sign you are somewhere the thread still hums.
